[[Drinkmaster Tahnu]] appears during [[The Drunken Master]]. At first, Tahnu is an [[ally]], but as you approach him, he will turn [[Foe|hostile]]. After the quest is finished he will start walking towards [[Kaineng Center]].

== Locations ==
* [[Kaineng City]]
** {{NPC location|Bukdek Byway}} (only during [[The Drunken Master]])

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Drunken Blow}}
* {{skill icon|Endure Pain}}
* {{skill icon|Enraged Smash}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Mighty Blow}}
* {{skill icon|Staggering Blow}}

== Notes ==
* Although he doesn't die immediately after defeated, he will eventually die upon reaching Kaineng Center, allowing his elite skill to be captured.
** A group of [[Canthan Peasant]]s may block his path, causing him not to die.
